fields.v: Criterion stated by the authors: clean replay in a fresh container passes setup + doctor + minimal_verify (per repository); no success threshold on the rate and no cost criterion (authors judge the generation cost 'acceptable', 'comparable to the effort required for manual repository setup', which is not measured). -- (1) BootstrapAgent + own multi-agent pipeline + DeepSeek-V4-Flash-2026-04-25 (temperature 1.0): success 197/212 (92.9%): ExecutionAgent 42/50, Installamatic 38/40, Repo2Run 117/122; median 43.8K tokens, 24.6 min per repository (P90 169.2K, 79.0 min). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors (per-repository clean-replay criterion only; authors' judgement 'effective for building most repositories'); cost: no criterion stated by the authors (authors' judgement 'acceptable'). -- (2) HerAgent (baseline; strongest reported baseline, agent/model not stated in this paper; whether re-run under the same verifier not stated): 179/212 (84.4%): 41/50, 34/40, 104/122. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors (unclear whether the clean-replay criterion was applied); cost: not reported. -- (3) Downstream Claude Code (headless, model not stated) cold, without .bootstrap but given the same verification commands (baseline): median wall time 346.3 s overall (ExecutionAgent 285.2 / Installamatic 337.8 / Repo2Run 391.9 s); median active tokens 46.3K (38.9K / 41.6K / 50.8K); total tokens 710.7K (597.9K / 594.4K / 797.8K). Quality: not reported (downstream success not reported); cost: no criterion stated by the authors. -- (4) Downstream Claude Code warm, with .bootstrap: median wall time 249.5 s (112.0 / 282.3 / 309.8 s); median active tokens 36.9K (19.6K / 36.6K / 43.1K); total tokens 419.4K (115.7K / 312.6K / 526.9K). Quality: not reported; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. -- Ablations (Repo2Run / ExecutionAgent / Installamatic success; full 95.9% / 84.0% / 95.0%): (5) w/o repository discovery (ablation) 76.2% / 52.0% / 70.0%; (6) w/o clean replay (ablation) 95.1% / 82.0% / 90.0%; (7) w/o trace-driven repair (ablation) 26.2% / 18.0% / 40.0%; (8) w/o warm-state repair (ablation): +4,839.9 / +851.6 / +421.9 min total time; (9) w/o sanity check (ablation): 5/122, 4/50, 2/40 false positives caught by the full system. Quality and cost for ablations: no criterion stated by the authors
fields.quote: Given that this time is comparable to the effort required for manual repository setup while producing a reusable build specification, we consider the overhead acceptable.
fields.why: The 'works' verdicts for configuration (1) rest on the authors' after-the-fact judgements ('effective for most repositories', overhead 'acceptable') and a per-repository pass criterion, not on a stated configuration-level success criterion, which the protocol (2026-11-23) requires for a verdict.
fields.doubt: Para a configuração (1) puseste 'funciona' em qualidade e custo. Os autores só dizem que o custo é 'aceitável' e o método 'eficaz' (pág. 6), sem critério de sucesso. Noutros estudos com critério só por tarefa puseste 'sem critério'. Decide se mantém 'funciona' ou passa a 'sem critério declarado pelos autores'.
